title: Use Seedance 2.0 on the Higgs platform to access it without geo restrictions
content:
Use Seedance 2.0 on the Higgs platform to access it without geo restrictions  
Generate videos from a single hero image plus prompts to create UGC, studio-style videos, lifestyle ads, and mixed-style ads
